title: Find the Highest Altitude
description:
[Source: LeetCode 1732]
There is a biker going on a road trip. The road trip consists of n + 1 points at different altitudes. The biker starts at point 0 with altitude 0. Return the highest altitude of a point.

Input Format:
First line: n
Second line: n space-separated gain integers

Output Format:
Highest altitude integer
